reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getScheduledAmount (missing/number/range dispatch, used by the UI); the diff writes a new near-identically named getScheduleAmount instead of changing it.

duplication.why: It collapses four inline copies into one, but the new helper duplicates getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch, leaving two competing amount definitions.

placement.why: The new helper is correctly placed in shared/schedules.ts beside the related schedule utilities.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount sites and the helper are touched.

maintainability.why: Two helpers named getScheduleAmount and getScheduledAmount with different range rules is a trap; the server now plans for the worst case while the UI, balance and budget templates still use the midpoint.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts: new getScheduleAmount bypasses the existing getScheduledAmount; budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own midpoint expression.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts is a renamed reshaping of getScheduledAmount's dispatch (null -> 0, number -> itself, range -> one value).

one_place.where: Rule changed only in the new getScheduleAmount (server forecast, schedules/app.ts, preview); getScheduledAmount (SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) and budget/schedule-template.ts still compute the midpoint.
